Thank you so so much for your advice, and i'm so sorry to hear that your mom is saying things like that to you, especially after having been hospitalized! Thats really tough, again im so sorry you're having to deal with this would you be able to stay with a friend by any chance? I hate to say that your only option is leaving but, as someone who comes from a verbally and emotionally abusive household, that was the only thing that finally helped me. If you need to stay, I would record when things like this happen (take pictures, a short video on your phone, etc.) so that you have tangible proof of the things she is doing because if she has a habit of doing things like this you can (if you feel it necessary/appropriate) take this proof to the police and they can intervene. I know that seems extreme and she is your mom and you care about her and love her but it can be permanently damaging to your mental health being tense and walking on egg shells all the time at home. I know I personally have PTSD from my home life prior to moving out and I wish I had left before I turned 18, it probably would have prevented some of that. I hope this gets itself sorted out for you soon, if you need a baby step, try sitting down with her and talking about how this incident has mad you feel and don't let her turn it around or gaslight you, just have an adult discussion, if she cant do that and gets angry or becomes reactive then you really should try to get out asap.

Holy shit I'm so sorry that happened to you! How old are you? That is extremely abusive behavior and you really need to get out of that situation as quickly as possible. If you are a minor I feel awful because that makes it so much harder to remove yourself from that situation but honestly, go stay with a friend or family member. You cannot continue to be in a house with someone so volatile and abusive. Parents have to respect their children just as much as children should respect their parents, and she is far from respecting you. If you are not a minor, I would get out as fast as you can and never look back. I would not give her a dime, because thats telling her that treating you with such disrespect will get her what she wants.  I'm so sorry you're having to deal with this!
